title: Masked source boundaries
responsibility: Tracks bracket depths and finds approximate statement and function-body bounds in masked source.

inputs.name: sourceNesting.masked
inputs.description: Masked source whose literal/comment contents no longer contribute brackets.

inputs.name: matchingBrace.nesting
inputs.description: Depth arrays previously computed from the same masked source.

inputs.name: matchingBrace.open
inputs.description: Offset of an opening curly brace.

inputs.name: statementEnd.nesting
inputs.description: Matching depth arrays for the source.

inputs.name: statementEnd.start
inputs.description: Offset at which statement scanning begins.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.masked
inputs.description: Masked source containing a signature and possible body.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.nesting
inputs.description: Matching depth arrays for the source.

inputs.name: bodyEnd.from
inputs.description: Offset after which to look for a function body.

outputs.name: sourceNesting
outputs.description: Curly and parenthesis/square-bracket depths before every character, with one trailing position.

outputs.name: matchingBrace
outputs.description: Inclusive closing-brace offset when depth returns to its opening level; last source offset if no close is found.

outputs.name: statementEnd
outputs.description: Inclusive statement end at a same-depth semicolon, recognized next statement or closing brace, otherwise the final source offset.

outputs.name: bodyEnd
outputs.description: Inclusive function-body end, skipping recognized return-type braces, or -1 for a bodiless/unrecognized signature.
